Thanks Kimberly — helpful recap.

Short answers:
- Procurement: yes, PO is the preferred path for engagements that will be contracted on our side. For pilots under €10k we sometimes accept card, but larger pilots / production require PO.
- Marketplace: We are evaluating AWS Marketplace for ISV procurement; interested, but legal needs to approve commercial terms — timeline uncertain.
- Vendor onboarding: we require vendor registration (vendor portal link below) + bank details + W-8/W-9 equivalent for Germany (we need your EU VAT cert if applicable).
- Invoice: please include our VAT ID (DE123456789) and the billing address below. Invoices need invoice number, invoice date, line items, VAT breakdown.
- Net terms: 30 days is standard; procurement can discuss 45 days with finance sign-off if needed.

Procurement will open a vendor ticket once we get the vendor portal submission. I'll loop procurement on the next email.
